reviews.t: Left my hair oily and feeling unclean.
reviews.x: I really wanted to like this product, but after using a few times, I am switching back to my old brand. This product smells incredible, but that's about all that was good for me: my hair never felt "clean" after using this, the conditioner didn't leave my hair soft (in fact if felt drier than before), and I found my scalp and hair oily just one day after shampooing, whereas I only needed to wash my hair two or three times with my old brand. Perhaps this just isn't the brand for me.

claims.text: Most reviewers love the product, reporting softer, more manageable, shinier hair.
Several reviewers say the shampoo does not lather well and requires using a lot of product.
A minority report the opposite effect, saying it left their hair dry, frizzy, or straw-like.
